productSpec.name: FreelanceOS
productSpec.thesis: Freelancers use 10+ tools. They need one app that does everything: invoicing, contracts, time tracking, project management, CRM, proposals, and AI to help with all of it.
productSpec.mvpFeatures:
- Invoice generation
- Contract templates
- Time tracking
- Project/task management
- Client CRM
- Proposal builder
- AI writing assistant
- Expense tracking
